summary: # CLO Skills Workshop - Making Zipper Pockets ## Introduction This video will explain the production of zipper pockets. ## Arrangement of Zipper Pocket Panels First is the arrangement of zipper pocket panels. We can combine the large and small panels. Then we can show the basic line of the panel. It is convenient for us to align the position of the pocket panel. 1. Select the pocket panel. 2. Click the quick arrangement button in the upper right corner of the positioning ball. 3. You can arrange the panel on our large panel using the blue arrow of the positioning ball. 4. Do not loosen the left and right keys; drag the mouse down. 5. When we move to the edge of the panel, the shadow appears, and it can be stopped. At this time, our pocket panel will be on our large panel. ## Overall Arrangement Next, we will arrange the panels. You can select the large panel and the pocket panel at the same time for an overall arrangement. 1. Open the arrangement point of the virtual model. 2. Select the panel and click the left button on the corresponding arrangement point. 3. You can complete the overall arrangement of our large and pocket panels. 4. The rest of the panels are also arranged according to the structure. ## Working with Panels After the arrangement, we can deal with the panel and the pocket panels. 1. First, select the collet outline tool. 2. Then, select the baseline on the pocket panel. 3. Click the return car to collet. 4. Next, select the free sewing tool and sew the pocket. Continue with the following steps: 1. Select the collet outline tool again. 2. Collet the zipper pattern. 3. Click the return car to collet. 4. Then, select the adjustment panel tool. 5. Click the right button on the internal pattern. 6. Choose to convert to move. The rest of the parts are sewn and made according to the normal structure of the part. This is the effect we achieved after completing the simulation. ## Making the Collet Outline Next, we will make the collet outline. To make it easier for us to check, we can close the basic line display to see the effect of the pocket. 1. Select the collet outline tool. 2. The addition of the collet can be added in the 3D window or the 2D window. ### Adding the Collet in 3D Window 1. Click the left button to start. 2. Follow the line of adding the zipper and slide the mouse to the bottom. 3. Click the left double-click to end. 4. Next, make the zipper on the other side by clicking the same button to start and double-clicking to end. ### Adding the Collet in 2D Window 1. Move the mouse to the 2D version. 2. Click the start button and double-click to end. 3. This is also the start button; double-click to end. 4. Then you can complete the addition of the zipper. ## Zipper Parameter Settings After adding the zipper, you can make some settings to the zipper parameters. 1. Select the move tool and then select the zipper. 2. In the property editor, you can edit the length of the zipper. 3. You can also edit the size of the zipper, selecting the number of zippers. 4. At the bottom, you can edit the total width of the zipper, which is 1.2 cm. After editing the number, let's simulate it. You can see that the zipper will simulate the width of the zipper at the bottom, fitting well on the zipper. ## Sewing the Zipper Ends Next, we can sew the zipper's two ends. After making the zipper, the handle of the zipper is on the two ends, and the zipper does not match with the button. For convenience, we can change the rendering type of the clothing to the texture of the surface. 1. Move the zipper to the bottom. 2. Drag our board to see the opening state. 3. Close the simulation while dragging the board. 4. Then you can use the line sewing tool to sew. ### Using the Sewing Tool 1. Use a pair of more sewing tools here. 2. Click on the board first, then press the Shift key without loosening it. 3. Click on the chain on one side and click on the other side again. 4. When clicking, please pay attention to the position and direction of the seam line. 5. Finally, release the Shift key to complete our sewing. ## Final Adjustments Simulate to see that our chain end is sewn together, and when pulling again, it will not open. ### Untying the Chain When we encounter the two ends of the chain with less fabric, for example, at the upper end, dragging this chain may make it more difficult to create a gap, which is not convenient for sewing. 1. At this time, we can select the chain. 2. In the attribute editor, find the option to sew the chain and turn it off. 3. Simulate again, and now the chain will be untied. 4. Lightly turn here to see the fabric of the pocket and the fabric on both sides of our chain are separated. ### Completing the Seam At this time, select the sewing tool on the middle line. 1. Click on the fabric of the pocket. 2. Press the Shift key and click on the zipper on both sides, paying attention to the position and direction of the click. 3. Then press the control button again for simulation to complete the seam. ## Appearance Adjustments After the zipper is done, you can adjust some appearance details. 1. First, select our zipper again. 2. Open the zipper option and select its opening. 3. Change it to a closed opening. If the zipper is not in the opening, select the opening in the 3D window and right-click to hide the opening. 4. Below is the setting of the zipper type. Select the zipper and click on the top to preset. 5. You can switch to different zipper types and adjust your wrong way from the other side. You can also set the zipper to the lower edge and select many zipper types. We also use the supporting parts to support the zipper to find the right fit. ### Conclusion You can choose every stucco from the top of the zipper or choose the middle one. Then you can select the bottom, follow the zipper on the right side, click on the shy, and then click on right killed. 以上就是关于我们拉链口袋的制作说明，希望能帮助到大家。
